title: FTC settlements may fall short of curbing pharmacy benefit managers
summary_en: The FTC’s deals with major drug middlemen may not do enough to lower what patients and employers pay for prescription drugs, said WashU Law’s Rachel Sachs.
title_cn: FTC settlements may fall short of curbing pharmacy benefit managers

title: Clearing the way for renewable carbon fiber production
summary_en: Researchers at the McKelvey School of Engineering developed a process to use waste materials in the production of carbon fiber, a key step to more sustainable manufacturing and stronger material design.
title_cn: Clearing the way for renewable carbon fiber production
